nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (every 15m)
nodes.notes: Synth reminder schedule. Trigger label TICK_15M. NO credentials / secrets stored in workflow JSON. Signing is BLOCKED_BY_N8N_SIGNER_DECISION (see C-N11-04).

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (daily digest 09:00 ICT)
nodes.notes: Daily morning digest. Same downstream flow as 15-min trigger. The 15-min tick and the daily digest converge to the same idempotency key per (nextActionId, day, audience, workflowRevision) so AC #15 holds.

nodes.name: Build envelope (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: No raw PII or secret. Window key is the UTC-minute bucket. correlationId is derived from stable fields only (workflow id+revision, execution id, trigger, minute). Signing is BLOCKED (see C-N11-04).

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: C-N11-04: NO credential / HMAC signing configured. authentication.type = 'none' is the only n8n-valid value when no signer node is wired; n8n cannot produce the N8N/0.3 signature profile declaratively. Status: BLOCKED_BY_N8N_SIGNER_DECISION.

nodes.name: Filter + Group (snooze, slaBucket, per-nextActionId)
nodes.notes: C-N11-02: emits one item per nextActionId, sorted by (dueAt, nextActionId). C-N11-01: classifies each item as routing = SEND | FALLBACK so the downstream Switch can pick exactly one ack-builder.

nodes.name: Build sendSyntheticReminder batches
nodes.notes: C-N11-02: one item per nextActionId. C-N11-03: ackBase derived from stable fields; no Date.now / Math.random. Output is emitted item-by-item so downstream IF/Switch dispatches per-item.

nodes.name: Switch routing (SEND vs FALLBACK)
nodes.notes: C-N11-01: IF/Switch picks exactly one downstream branch per item. Index 0 = SEND, Index 1 = FALLBACK. The two branches converge ONCE into Build acknowledgement batches.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (sendSyntheticReminder)
nodes.notes: C-N11-04: authentication.type='none' (no built-in HMAC type in n8n httpRequest). Status: BLOCKED_BY_N8N_SIGNER_DECISION.

nodes.name: Build ack from send
nodes.notes: C-N11-03: ackBase is deterministic and propagated from the send envelope.

nodes.name: Build ack from fallback
nodes.notes: C-N11-03: deterministic ackBase derived from (nextActionId, day, audience). No Date.now / Math.random.

nodes.name: Build acknowledgement batches
nodes.notes: C-N11-01: both branches converge here. C-N11-03: dedupe guard on ackBase ensures one ack per logical reminder. No Date.now() / Math.random().

parameters.content:
## n8n/1.1 — Follow-up / SLA Reminder (LOCAL/MOCK PoC)

### Blocked status
C-N11-04 — BLOCKED_BY_N8N_SIGNER_DECISION. n8n `httpRequest` v4.2 has no built-in HMAC credential type. Workflow JSON declares `authentication.type = 'none'`; the N8N/0.3 signature profile cannot be produced declaratively. Unblock requires either (a) a custom signer node, or (b) a custom credential type bound to the N8N/0.3 signing algorithm. See SECURITY-BOUNDARY.md.

### Flow (per item)
  1. Trigger: 15-min tick OR daily 09:00 ICT digest.
  2. Build envelope (listDueNextActions).
  3. POST /v1/automation/dispatch (list) -> response.
  4. Filter snoozeMode==SNOOZED and status!=OPEN; bucket DUE_SOON / OVERDUE.
     Sort by (dueAt, nextActionId). Emit ONE item per nextActionId.
  5. Build sendSyntheticReminder batches -> emit kind=send or kind=fallback per item.
  6. Switch routing: kind=send -> POST /v1/automation/dispatch (send) -> Build ack from send.
     kind=fallback -> Build ack from fallback (no HTTP send call).
  7. Build acknowledgement batches (dedupe by ackBase) -> POST /v1/automation/dispatch (acknowledgeReminder).

### Boundaries
  - body organizationId is NEVER authority; registry-resolved org/conn wins.
  - Workflow never mutates NextAction state, Handling SLA, canonical state.
  - Snooze affects notification ONLY; SLA/canonical unchanged.
  - Idempotency keys derived from (nextActionId, day, audience, workflowRevision). No Date.now() / Math.random().
  - Logs are redacted; no secret, signature, raw body, PII.
  - Synthetic channel only (DASHBOARD_ONLY); no email/SMS/Zalo/Chatwoot.
  - No infinite retry; idempotency-key dedupe handles retry; kill switch fail-closed.
  - One acknowledgement per logical reminder (dedupe by ackBase).
  - Reorder-safe: items are sorted by (dueAt, nextActionId) before key derivation.

### Local only
  - Exercised by Node-based local runner/simulator in apps/n8n-workflows/local-runner.mjs.
  - DO NOT IMPORT into the n8n CRM instance until signer decision is made AND T0 issues the import command AND operator provisions env vars + signer node / credential.
  - JSON_STRUCTURE_VERIFIED, LOCAL_SIMULATOR_VERIFIED. N8N_RUNTIME_NOT_EXECUTED.

signerProfile.required: custom signer node OR custom credential type bound to N8N/0.3 signature algorithm
signerProfile.approvedLegacyAlgorithm: sha256(input || secret) double-canonical digest (NOT real HMAC)
